scope: Retained test failures and topology differences, not silently counted as passes

events.event: Unsafe Removal notice consumed the beginning of a probe command; no matching UDP report arrived. Screenshot shows only the token entered as a command.

QEMU device_add without port selected port 2. The fictional mixed NIC obtained a different instance ending in 02&02 and Windows 2000 requested its first binding (problem 1, zero replies). This is not a same-port recovery pass. Removing this instance and explicitly using port 1 restored the previously installed instance and network/input without reinstalling a NIC.

harness_change: mixed_key_observer.py now holds a global flock around its UDP receiver so concurrent independent guests cannot bind the same port or consume each other's reports.
